method_note: ESMATS 2027 (Milan) has not yet taken place, so the 21st ESMATS (Lausanne, 24-26 Sep 2025) is analyzed. The official agenda has 9 oral technical sessions with 41 papers. Their titles are mostly generic ('Mechanisms 1-3', 'Tribology 1-2'), so each oral paper is mapped from its title as 1 unit split across at most 2 keywords. The 17 posters, the three 5-minute 'New Development' pitch sessions, invited talks and training courses were excluded. Tribology/lubrication/bearing-material papers are split 0.5 mechanisms / 0.5 structures (materials). Papers whose main subject is deployment (masts, sail membranes, baffles, appendage-deployment test rigs) map fully to deployable-structures. Papers where deployment is one aspect get 0.5 (lubrication for large deployable antennas, an SMA hinge for rover solar-array deployment). Keywords below 0.02 (earth-obs, launch, mechatronics, osam, soft-robotics, space-robotics, space-systems, spacecraft-gnc, ssa-debris; together 0.11 of paper-units) were dropped and the remaining weights renormalized to sum to 1.
